taxonomy.name: a word stopped me
taxonomy.treatment: define or own the word first (glossary, words sheet), then re-serve

taxonomy.name: wrong method, or did not know how
taxonomy.treatment: theory sheet, then a drill block, then the 2-day recheck

taxonomy.name: misread what was asked
taxonomy.treatment: re-serve with a check that tests the question's own words

taxonomy.name: right idea, wrong answer form
taxonomy.treatment: answer-form drill; the check line tests the form

taxonomy.name: careless slip (slip account, same step done right elsewhere)
taxonomy.treatment: ladder only; the written check should catch it

taxonomy.name: ran out of time
taxonomy.treatment: pace drill; check the sheet size against the budget
